MOD_CONST = 1000000007

def compute_power(base, exp):
    if exp == 1:
        return base
    half = compute_power(base, exp // 2)
    val = (half * half) % MOD_CONST
    if exp % 2 == 0:
        return val
    return (val * base) % MOD_CONST

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())

    if k == 0:
        print(compute_power(p, p - 1))
        return

    if k == 1:
        print(compute_power(p, p))
        return

    m_count = 1
    t = k
    while True:
        m_count += 1
        t = (t * k) % p
        if t == 1:
            print(compute_power(p, (p - 1) // m_count))
            return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
